title: Gommateshwara statue, Shravanabelagola
summary: The Gommateshwara statue is a monolithic figure of Bahubali standing atop Vindhyagiri Hill at Shravanabelagola, Karnataka. The minister and Ganga general Chavundaraya (Chamundaraya) had it made, and two government sources date it to 981 CE. Heights given are 58 feet (Karnataka Tourism) and approximately 17.7 m (IGNCA).

uncertainty.note: Both opened sources give 981 AD; other works cited in search results give 982-983 or a 978-993 window but were not opened. End is the present.
